name: diddipay-fund-staging-tests
description: Black-box Bruno tests for DiddiPay and DiddiFund staging

scripts.test:staging:contract: npm run prereport && bru run "01 Health" "08 Payment Contract" "11 Security Surface" --env Staging --reporter-junit reports/contract.xml --reporter-json reports/contract.json --reporter-skip-all-headers --reporter-skip-body
scripts.test:staging:security: npm run prereport && bru run "11 Security Surface" --env Staging --reporter-junit reports/security.xml --reporter-json reports/security.json --reporter-skip-all-headers --reporter-skip-body
scripts.test:staging:s2s: npm run prereport && bru run "09 Payment S2S" --env Staging --reporter-junit reports/s2s.xml --reporter-json reports/s2s.json --reporter-skip-all-headers --reporter-skip-body
scripts.test:staging:fund: npm run prereport && bru run "10 DiddiFund PaymentIntent" --env Staging --reporter-junit reports/fund-payment.xml --reporter-json reports/fund-payment.json --reporter-skip-all-headers --reporter-skip-body
scripts.test:staging:legacy: npm run prereport && bru run "02 Wallet" "03 Fund" "04 Negative - Auth" "05 Negative - Validation" "06 Negative - Business Rules" "07 Negative - Ownership" --env Staging --reporter-junit reports/legacy.xml --reporter-json reports/legacy.json --reporter-skip-all-headers --reporter-skip-body
scripts.test:staging:all: npm run prereport && bru run --env Staging --reporter-junit reports/all.xml --reporter-json reports/all.json --reporter-skip-all-headers --reporter-skip-body
